summary: Travel + Leisure Co. filed an 8-K to report the issuance of $900M 6.250% senior secured notes due 2031 via a fifth supplemental indenture. Proceeds will refinance existing 6.625% secured notes due July 2026, repay revolver borrowings, and for general corporate purposes. The notes are senior secured obligations ranking equally with other senior debt. No acquisition, divestiture, or special-situation event is involved; this is a routine debt refinancing.
